wsjHeadlines.description: The upper house of Swiss parliament backed a proposal to ease new capital demands on the group, while rejecting a stricter requirement in a bill put forward by the country’s government.

wsjHeadlines.description: Shares rose 4%, taking the stock’s year-to-date gain to nearly 10%, after the bank said it is cutting costs and growing revenue to boost profitability through the end of the decade, including widening its use of AI.

wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks ended mixed as buzz about AI products propelled large tech companies to more record highs even as energy inflation fears lingered.

wsjHeadlines.description: Oil futures were gaining after falling the previous five sessions on optimism about oil flows out of the Middle East and renewed efforts to restart talks between the U.S. and Iran.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dollar Jumps to 8-Week High on Fed Rate-Hike Bets
wsjHeadlines.description: The U.S. dollar rose to its highest level since late July against a basket of currencies Wednesday as markets bet on the Federal Reserve raising interest rates further.

wsjHeadlines.description: The dollar strengthened and the Fed’s decision to raise interest rates last week has made the dollar more attractive, Standard Chartered said.
